claims.summary: Over any field of odd characteristic p, for an odd-dimensional root curve n>=3, put B=2^(n-1),c=(n-3)/2,kappa=O(cH),P0=(0,1,...,1). If M=m*p^v annihilates [H-BP0], p does not divide m, t>=v, and Phi_t=([T^(p^t-1)]fi*fj/W) on a basis of H0(kappa) is nonsingular, then every d=c+m*e*p^t>=n-2 with e>0,p not dividing e has classical original Vd at a moving generic point. This yields original generic normality by transport. A singular cup matrix does not decide higher lifting.
claims.assessment: Working all-parameter sufficient criterion: exact torsion trivialization leaves a deformation whose first coefficient is a nonzero multiple of T^(-p^t); Serre duality identifies its full section-lifting obstruction with Phi_t. A primitive generic section would contradict its invertibility. Medium review passed, including removal of unused perfectness; no ordinariness or positivity assumption.
claims.rationale: Retains original degrees and full coupled cohomology after symbolically removing the prime-power delay identified by the smooth precision obstruction. Standard section-lifting methods are credited; no claim of a complete exception algorithm.
claims.next_action: Analyze general central line bundles and higher lifting maps to seek a compact certificate for remaining degree classes.
